title: Beyond Affine Reconstruction: Multi-Resolution Transformer DeepONets for the Radiative Transfer Equation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck. Neural operators can accelerate these computations by learning solution operators from offline simulation data. However, conventional DeepONet surrogates rely on fixed-grid inputs and affine reconstruction, limiting their flexibility across resolutions and their approximation accuracy at a fixed latent dimension. In this paper, we develop a transformer-based DeepONet for multi-resolution RTE surrogate modelling. The proposed approach combines a Perceiver encoder, which maps temperature and absorption coefficient fields at different spatial resolutions into a fixed-size latent representation, with a cross-attention decoder that enables non-affine reconstruction of the radiative intensity. This architecture allows a single model to process inputs at varying resolutions without resampling them

translated_title: 超越仿射重构：用于辐射传输方程的多分辨率Transformer DeepONets
translated_abstract: 辐射换热在火灾模拟中起着主导作用，而求解辐射传输方程（RTE）是其中的计算瓶颈。神经算子可以通过从离线仿真数据中学习解算子来加速这些计算。然而，传统的DeepONet代理模型依赖于固定网格输入和仿射重构，这限制了其在不同分辨率之间的灵活性，以及在固定潜在维度下的逼近精度。本文开发了一种基于Transformer的DeepONet用于多分辨率RTE代理建模。所提出的方法将Perceiver编码器（将不同空间分辨率的温度场和吸收系数场映射为固定大小的潜在表示）与交叉注意力解码器（实现辐射强度的非仿射重构）相结合。该架构使单一模型能够处理不同分辨率的输入，而无需对输入进行重采样。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的多分辨率DeepONet，通过Perceiver编码器与交叉注意力解码器实现辐射传输方程的非仿射重构，使单一模型无需重采样即可处理不同分辨率的输入，突破了传统DeepONet固定网格和仿射重构的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transformer-based multi-resolution DeepONet that combines a Perceiver encoder with a cross-attention decoder for non-affine reconstruction of the radiative transfer equation, enabling a single model to handle inputs at varying resolutions without resampling and overcoming the fixed-grid and affine limitations of conventional DeepONets.
